name: Youth Train in Trades (North Vancouver School District)
org: North Vancouver School District 44 with BCIT, VCC and SkilledTradesBC
what_you_do: Take a trades class while in high school. Examples are welding, millwright, car repair and electrician basics. The school district pays the tuition.
who_can_apply: Domestic students in North Vancouver School District, mainly grade 12. Seats are limited.
pay_detail: Tuition covered by the school board
deadline_text: Deadline is the end of February for programs the next school year. Year not stated.
how_to_apply: Talk to your school Career Program teacher. If you missed the deadline, email jkinakin@sd44.ca.
